bullets.text: Physical AI Revolutionizes Robotics - **Physical AI** relies on robust networks for real-time decision-making in robotics and automation.
Starlink Enhances Space Safety - **Starlink** will lower satellite orbits to improve safety and reduce collision risks.
India's 5G Expansion Slows - India added 4,112 new 5G BTS in December, bringing the total to nearly 519,000 sites.
Singtel Trials 50Gbps Fiber - **Singtel** launches a 50Gbps fiber trial to support AI and immersive digital services.
Hollow Core Fiber Breakthrough - **Microsoft** scales hollow core fiber production, promising lower latency and higher efficiency.
Baltic Cable Damage Investigation - An investigation is underway after damage to **Arelion's** BCS East submarine cable.
UK Cybersecurity Investment - The UK government allocates £210m to enhance public sector cybersecurity measures.
SoftBank's AI Infrastructure Bet - **SoftBank's** acquisition of **DigitalBridge** reflects a shift in telecom infrastructure for AI demands.
Fintech-Telco Collaboration MoU - **Freedom Telecom International** and **e&** sign an MoU to explore fintech and telecom synergies.
VoWiFi Demand on the Rise - **VoWiFi** technology is gaining traction, enhancing voice services in areas with poor cellular coverage.
